under Sections 363, 452, 323, 506, 376 AB IPC, 5/6 POCSO Act, Police Station Jewar, District Gautam Budh Nagar pending in the Court of Additional Sessions Judge (POCSO Act), Court No.1,

3. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State.
4.
It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the matter is pending since 2023 but as of now no evidence has been adduced by the prosecution.

It is also submitted that the opposite party no.2 is not cooperating with the Court concerned and is adopting delaying tactics in disposal of the said case and only dates are being fixed in the matter.

The Court concerned is not taking Sri Deepak vs State Of U.P. And Another on 4 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21922661/
1 proper interest in disposal of the said case.

sentences.text: 5. Learned AGA and learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 opposed the prayer and submitted that the opposite party no.2 / accused is already in jail.
6. I have considered the submissions and perused the record.

7. It reveals from the perusal of the order sheets that F.I.R. in this case was lodged in the year 2023 and the case is pending at the stage of evidence but no evidence is being adduced by the prosecution.

In the circumstances, the applicant is directed to be vigilant in producing the witnesses before the Court and the trial court is directed to make all possible endeavours for expeditious disposal of the case, preferably within a period of one year from the date of production of certified copy of this order before it, if there is no legal impediment.
It is further directed that no unnecessary adjournment will be sought/granted.

8. It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
9.
With the above observations, the application stands disposed of.
